rules.rationale: This is the terminating equation of the mathematical rolling-window summary advanceTo: once I is past N, the summarized result is the current fourth window value D.
This is the recursive equation defining advanceTo: it shifts the four-value window, inserts the sum of the window, increments I, and continues the mathematical summary.
This equation defines the fib4Spec base value at index 0 as 0.
This equation defines the fib4Spec base value at index 1 as 0.
This equation defines the fib4Spec base value at index 2 as 2.
This equation defines the fib4Spec base value at index 3 as 0.
For N at least 4, this equation defines fib4Spec by initializing the advanceTo mathematical summary with the contract's base window (0, 0, 2, 0) at loop index 4.
